name: CakeDream
source:
In CakeDream, you're in a magical world where you go on a cake ingredient-gathering adventure to make yourself a cake. Along the way, you may encounter choices that result in inevitable consequences. 

[edited from [url=https://clover1031.itch.io/cakedream]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《CakeDream》中，你置身于一个神奇的世界中，进行一场收集蛋糕原料的冒险，为自己制作一个蛋糕。一路上，你可能会遇到一些选择，而这些选择会导致不可避免的后果。

[编辑自[url=https://clover1031.itch.io/cakedream]Itch.io[/url]]
